targetUrl.title: Target Website URL
targetUrl.description: Enter the website URL to visit, read, scroll, and execute clicks on.

deviceType.title: Device & OS Emulation
deviceType.description: Choose between Desktop OS (Windows 11 / macOS) or Mobile (iOS iPhone / Android) with authentic touch emulation.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Select Apify Residential (recommended for high trust score) or Datacenter proxies.

dwellSeconds.title: Post-Click Dwell Duration (seconds)
dwellSeconds.description: How many seconds to keep the clicked ad page / tab active before complete data wipe.

nativeAdChance.title: Native Ad Click Probability (%)
nativeAdChance.description: Percentage probability to prioritize clicking native ad banners, Social Bar push ads, or ad widgets.

readDurationSec.title: Human Read & Scroll Simulation (seconds)
readDurationSec.description: Time spent naturally reading and scrolling the page before executing a click.

maxCycles.title: Total Simulation Cycles (1 View per Cycle)
maxCycles.description: Number of unique, fully isolated single-view sessions to execute.
